scenarios.expected: The selected Document Version is explicitly pinned and the Contract reaches the chosen Stage without a connector. A Version kind alone does not set the Executed pin; unsupported users cannot perform the legal action.
scenarios.actual: Upload document filed the draft as the first Document (734-rev-draft-legal_team_member.pdf); Out for signature was chosen from the Stage control; the Approvals section offers no Send for signature and the record has no Envelope. Add version created Version 2 with kind executed on 734-rev-draft-legal_team_member.pdf; the downloaded Version 2 bytes equal the uploaded file; isExecuted is still false (kind alone does not designate); the page shows the Executed kind pill (1 cell) and no executed designation. Version 2 is the current Version, so its Mark as executed copy sits in the Document row's Actions menu (a separate version-level menu existed 0 times); designated, cleared with Unmark as executed copy, and designated again; the Status stayed Out for signature; 734-rev-draft-legal_team_member.pdf is the primary Document. Version 3 is current; Version 2 keeps the executed designation and downloads the original executed bytes; the earlier versions expand under the row; Status still Out for signature. Active chosen from the Stage control; History shows the status change; zero Envelopes on the record. Ravi Menon read the Document and downloaded Version 2 (200) but his row menu (absent) has no executed action and the API answered 403; the archived Contract showed no Document actions and refused the designation change with 409; after Restore Version 2 is still designated.
